# CaptionButtonKind

`Flare.Components.IDE.CaptionButtonKind`

The command a title-bar caption control represents. The kind selects the semantic marker and the close control's danger paint; the host still supplies the visible glyph, the accessible label and the command.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Minimize` | `0` | Minimize the window. |
| `Maximize` | `1` | Maximize the window. |
| `Restore` | `2` | Restore the window from its maximized state. |
| `Close` | `3` | Close the window. This is the only kind that takes the danger paint. |

## Used by components

- `FlareCaptionButton`
